description: Security Scorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity rankings. Its patented technology makes organizations more resilient with self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting and cyber insurance underwriting.
Semgrep, formerly known as r2c, is a code scanning platform for finding first and third-party security vulnerabilities in your code base.

Pilot is the largest provider of bookkeeping, tax preparation and CFO services for startups and small businesses. It combines intelligent software with world-class accountants to deliver quality books at an affordable price. Pilot automates the mundane work that’s not worth users’ valuable time.

Oso puts security in the hands of the makers by presenting security as code. It gives developers a library for authorization, with the freedom to shape and extend it as their needs evolve. By offloading this mental work, developers all over the world can shift their focus to moving fast.

Middesk delivers business verifications, legal and regulatory checks, and industry classification products to businesses that work with businesses. With its modern compliance and risk tools, Middesk offers end-to-end solutions so companies can screen and monitor customers.
Apollo is an end-to-end AI sales platform to help companies grow their business. Its integrated GTM suite builds pipeline, enriches data and assists with sales calls.

Profound is an AI visibility and content creation platform that helps brands monitor and optimize how they appear in AI-powered search results. As consumers increasingly turn to AI assistants for product research, Profound gives marketers the tools to control their presence in AI systems. Profound empowers businesses to win in a future where AI agents, not blue links, drive discovery.
Physical Intelligence is building a foundation model for robotics, bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world.

sample_title: Staff Product Marketing Manager, Developer Experience
description: Cockroach Labs provides a cloud-native, distributed SQL database for critical enterprise applications.
Citizen is a personal safety app and mobile protection service.
Traversal is an AI SRE agent that troubleshoots, resolves and prevents production incidents—so engineers can ship features, not fixes.
LangChain is an LLM programming framework for AI applications. Its open-source toolkit allows the growing community of developers to build sophisticated, data-aware applications on top of LLMs.

Turnkey allows developers to generate and manage private keys across blockchains. With a simple API, builders can spin-up thousands of wallets, sign millions of transactions, and set permissions to ensure only allowed transactions are signed. Turnkey was built on a minimal, immutable, and deterministic operating system, designed for environments requiring paranoia and accountability putting builders in control of their keys while providing institutional-grade security.

Tavus is a research lab pioneering human computing. Their real-time human simulation models let machines see, hear, respond, and even look real, enabling meaningful face-to-face conversations with people. Imagine a therapist that anyone can afford; a personal trainer that adapts to your schedule; medical assistants that can give every patient the attention they need, available 24/7, in every language.

Sandstone enables modern in-house teams to move at the speed of AI, deliver better outcomes and create measurable business value. It unifies legal data, drives end-to-end workflows and organizes business context within the tools you already use. Sandstone is the home for AI-native legal departments.

AI agents are reshaping how security teams investigate threats, and they need a radically different kind of data layer to do it. Scanner indexes security logs directly in S3, making petabytes of data searchable in seconds at a fraction of traditional SIEM costs. Customers including Notion, Ramp and BeyondTrust use Scanner to run detections across years of data. AI agents now execute over 80% of queries on the platform.

WithCoverage replaces traditional insurance brokers with a new category of risk management. The company combines elite risk advisors with proprietary technology to give businesses full visibility into policies, exposures, compliance and claims. Its AI agents automate workflows, improve decision making, and deliver a materially higher standard of service and cost savings.

Crosby is the hybrid AI law company that helps rapidly growing businesses execute faster. Crosby combines the speed and intelligence of AI with the safety of lawyers-in-the-loop to review contracts in minutes. Crosby negotiates MSAs, DPAs and NDAs for fast-growing businesses, using speed and intelligence to reach agreement faster, and unblock sales teams.

Eon transforms your cloud backups into an accessible, useful asset. Use Eon to back up your entire cloud environment with automatic mapping and classification, so you only store what you need. Nothing more, nothing less.

Tacto is the AI-based operating system for future-proof supply chains in mid-sized industrials. As the central hub connecting these organizations with their supplier base, Tacto streamlines all procurement workflows, effortlessly ensures compliant and sustainable supply chains, and enables efficient material sourcing. With its solution, Tacto empowers mid-cap industrial organizations to future-proof their supply chains by intelligently procuring materials under optimal conditions with minimal effort.

Powered by generative AI, Gladia is an audio intelligence API distinguished by exceptional accuracy and speed of transcription, extended multilingual capabilities, and state-of-the-art features, including speaker separation, word-level timestamps, and code-switching. It allows companies to easily embed language AI into their products to derive valuable insights from audio data.

Listen Labs is an autonomous researcher that talks to thousands of customers to find out what they want and why. Its AI platform goes from market question to interview design, participant sourcing and response analysis, delivering insights in hours instead of weeks.

Dust is an AI operating system for smart teams. It reshapes information management in the workplace by combining multiple large language models to process information, making it readily available when needed and in the format that makes sense. Dust can augment humans, enhance productivity, foster diversity and facilitate a more dynamic, personalized work experience.

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars instantly—whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products could be rebuilt from the ground up today, they would look like Fin.

Magic Eden is the leading destination for NFT discovery, expression, and ownership across digital cultures. Led by former crypto, tech, and hospitality leaders, Magic Eden is driving the next billion users to Web3 by providing a user-friendly platform equipped with powerful minting and trading solutions. Magic Eden brings dynamic cultural moments onto the blockchain, empowering users across thousands of communities to create and collect unique NFTs.
Houzz is a marketplace for homeowners and home professionals. It’s where homeowners get ideas for their projects, buy products from vendors, and find the help they need to bring their vision to life.
Found gives self-employed people the support and confidence to work for themselves. It offers an all-in-one business banking, bookkeeping and tax solution for self-employed businesses.
Domino Data Lab’s platforms help data scientists build and deploy AI applications. Its tool not only trains models, but monitors performance once they’ve gone live.

Founded by three ex-Splunkers on a mission to get the most out of machine data, Cribl helps customers easily sift through data to find the nuggets they need. Its innovative and customizable controls route security and machine data where it has the most value—and with a singular focus on assuring customers have complete control to shape their data. As data needs evolve, LogStream evolves too, helping to get the right data, to the right destinations, in the right formats, at the right time.

Bunkerhill Health empowers leading health systems across the country to turn their best ideas into reality. Its agentic AI platform, Carebricks, gives health systems a single consolidated foundation for enterprise-wide AI, letting them design, build and deploy agents across clinical, operational and administrative work.
Clay makes creative tools that help businesses grow by improving their customer research to scale personalized outreach. Its AI agent helps RevOps and growth teams implement any outreach idea.
Captions is an AI-powered creative studio. Their goal is to enable anyone, anywhere to produce studio-quality videos with just a few quick taps.

Noom is the world’s leading behavior change company focused on disrupting the weight loss and healthcare industries. Combining the power of AI, mobile tech and psychology with empathetic personal coaches, Noom helps people live healthier lives by changing their long-term habits.
Neros develops and manufactures advanced unmanned drone systems for battlefield defense with a U.S. supply chain.

Zafran is a threat exposure management platform that integrates with security tools to reveal, remediate and mitigate all infrastructure risks. Its agentless approach reveals what is truly exploitable, while reducing manual effort.
